implementation.uapi: Added AGI_LC_ACCEL_ACCOUNT_BATCH_MAX=64, struct agi_lc_accel_device_account_batch, and additive AGI_LC_ACCEL_DEVICE_ACCOUNT_BATCH ioctl 0x6b; the existing single-entry ABI remains unchanged.
implementation.batch_semantics: The kernel copies at most 64 account entries, processes them in order, returns completed count and last-entry status, copies updated entries back, and stops on the first error.
implementation.security: The batch path reuses the validated single-entry authorization, tenant ownership, overflow, memory-limit, release-underflow, event-publication, and telemetry-loss checks; malformed zero-count input is rejected with EINVAL.
implementation.productivity_path: The batch path amortizes the accelerator mutex across the entire batch and uses u64_to_user_ptr for portable UAPI pointer conversion.
implementation.selftest: Tenant QEMU selftest verifies four-entry completion, malformed-input rejection, and a 256-single versus 64-batch throughput comparison with event delivery disabled for the benchmark.
implementation.commit: FAISAL accelerator: add batched accounting fast path

benchmark.comparison: 256 single-entry ioctl operations versus 64 four-entry batch ioctl operations, equal total entries, event delivery disabled during timing
benchmark.metric: speedup_x100 = single_total_ns * 100 / batch_total_ns; values above 100 indicate lower measured batch total time in that run
benchmark.interpretation: Three QEMU runs measured a median 1.14x batch-over-single total-time ratio for this bounded workload. This is not a claim of universal accelerator performance improvement; physical devices and production workloads remain unmeasured.

release_gate.reason: M155 is bounded QEMU/software validation. Operator-controlled signing, stable/LTS forward-port qualification, independent build-farm qualification, physical accelerator qualification, and external security governance remain required.
release_gate.hardware_claim: No physical GPU, NPU, VRAM, IOMMU, DMA, vendor-driver, reset, or fleet qualification is claimed.

known_limitations: Benchmark results are from QEMU TCG and a small synthetic account payload; they do not establish production performance on physical accelerators.
The batch path still emits one event per entry and stops on the first error; it is not a transactional all-or-nothing accounting operation.
The kernel remains based on the Linux v7.2-rc7 development line and has not completed stable or LTS forward-port requalification.
The recorded build is not independently reproduced on separate physical builders and artifacts are unsigned.
Durable execution regression passed, but M155 does not claim new durable-execution functionality.
